entries.t: <FACE:00>Whoa, there's places<NL>like this too…<WAIT>…Could you ski here?<WAIT><FACE:05>Don't be so laid-back!<NL>It's freezing!<WAIT>Let's just grab this<NL>Block already!
<FACE:08>What?! What was that<NL>giant yell?!<WAIT><FACE:03>Sounds like it's from<NL>the speakers…<NL>
<FACE:7D>It shook a lot-robo?<NL>But so close-robo!<WAIT>One more push-robo!<NL>

<FACE:7F>Now! The Sperobo Gang<NL>Shout Contest is hot!<WAIT>One more push and the<NL>avalanche hits-robo!<NL><WAIT>If the avalanche seals<NL>this Block off,<WAIT><PLAYER> and his gang<NL>can't get past-robo!<WAIT>Then Boss Nyuudou will<NL>reward us-robo!
<FACE:04>True, if we're buried<NL>in snow, we're stuck
<FACE:08>It's those speakers!<NL>If we shut them off…<WAIT><FACE:09>Isn't there some good<NL>way to do it…
<FACE:06>Go find us a way,<NL>and make it quick!
<FACE:19>I'm good at skiing!<NL>Want me to teach you?
<FACE:15>What are you saying!<NL>I'm better than you!<WAIT><FACE:14>I'll teach ya, leader!
<FACE:00>This is it!<WAIT>This is what runs<NL>those speakers…
<FACE:05>Oh, you're right…<NL><WAIT>This is the cable for<NL>that speaker!
<FACE:0A>Hurry up and cut it<NL>with your Medabot,<WAIT><PLAYER>!
<FACE:08>That lot over there<NL>are making a racket
<FACE:05>Looks like they<NL>noticed us<WAIT><FACE:19>They look really angry<NL>-robo!<WAIT><FACE:14>They're coming this<NL>way!
<FACE:01>Fighting them head on<NL>is a bad idea!<WAIT>Hide and regroup!<WAIT>I want a Medabot for<NL>this field, too…
<FACE:04>Er, well…<WAIT><FACE:06>Finish them off quick<NL>and take this Block!
<FACE:7E>Oi! You lot! Some<NL>prank, that-robo!<WAIT>Right, we'll teach you<NL>a…
<FACE:06>Yes, yes, you lost!<NL><WAIT>Now clear off, the<NL>lot of you!
<FACE:08>Look out! That shake<NL>was the biggest yet!

<FACE:08>There'll be an<NL>avalanche! <PLAYER>!<WAIT><FACE:05>Take control of this<NL>Block, quickly!<WAIT><FACE:03>What! But…<WAIT><FACE:05>What are you saying!<NL><WAIT>Hurry, or we won't be<NL>able to go on at all!<WAIT><FACE:04>No… um…<NL><WAIT>the avalanche will…
